# DSCodex

> DSCodex is an open-source loopback router that adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to the model picker of the stock ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI, and Codex IDE extension while keeping GPT on ChatGPT OAuth. It runs only on the user's machine and does not fork or patch Codex.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex
Latest release: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.2.0
License: MIT

DSCodex is not DeepSeek's official Codex setup (that setup replaces GPT with an API-key provider). It is not DSCode (https://github.com/thinkany-ai/dscode), not DeepCodex, and not a chatgpt.com web plugin.

## Key facts

- Picker entry: `🐳 DeepSeek Flash` (slug `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, wire name `deepseek-flash`, currently DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)
- DeepSeek path: native Responses API at `api.deepseek.com/responses` (tool loops, native vision, encrypted compaction)
- GPT path: unmodified OAuth passthrough to `chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`
- Install: `node src/cli.mjs key set` → `install` → `start` → `doctor` (six checks)
- Platforms: macOS / Linux / Windows; the ChatGPT desktop picker integration is macOS-first
- Reasoning effort: the catalog exposes High (`high`, Juice 75) and Max (`max`, Juice 100; picker default). The router folds `low`/`medium`/`high` to `high` and everything else to `max`. The hosted DeepSeek API rejects integer Juice 1–100 and `ultra` with HTTP 400.
